_comment: Literature search queries for BioLitAgent literature_scout agent. Monitored against PubMed (NCBI E-utilities) and bioRxiv APIs.

queries.name: Upstream Perfusion & Cell Culture
queries.pubmed_query: ("CHO cells" OR "Chinese hamster ovary" OR "HEK293" OR "mammalian cell culture" OR "suspension cell culture") AND (perfusion OR fed-batch OR "continuous bioprocessing") AND (bioreactor OR "viable cell density" OR titer OR "specific productivity") AND (biomanufacturing OR biopharmaceutical OR "protein production") NOT ("toxicology" OR "ecotoxicology" OR "zebrafish" OR "tea" OR "plant tissue" OR "food fermentation" OR "beverage")

queries.name: Downstream Continuous Chromatography
queries.pubmed_query: ("Protein A" OR "affinity chromatography" OR "ion exchange chromatography" OR "hydrophobic interaction chromatography" OR "multimodal chromatography") AND (continuous OR "tangential flow filtration" OR TFF OR multicolumn) AND (mAb OR "monoclonal antibody" OR biopharmaceutical OR "recombinant protein") NOT ("toxicology" OR "ecotoxicology" OR "tea" OR "food" OR "beverage")

queries.name: Analytical Characterization & CQAs
queries.pubmed_query: ("monoclonal antibody" OR biologic OR "recombinant protein" OR "therapeutic protein") AND (glycosylation OR "charge variants" OR "mass spectrometry" OR "multi-attribute method" OR MAM) AND (CQA OR "critical quality attribute" OR "quality by design" OR QbD) NOT ("toxicology" OR "tea" OR "food" OR "plant")

queries.name: Hybrid Modeling & Digital Process Tools
queries.pubmed_query: (bioprocess OR biomanufacturing OR "mammalian cell culture" OR "microbial fermentation" OR "precision fermentation" OR "recombinant protein") AND ("digital twin" OR "hybrid model" OR "hybrid modeling" OR "mechanistic model" OR "machine learning") AND ("biopharmaceutical" OR "CHO" OR "monoclonal antibody" OR "titer" OR "bioreactor") NOT ("toxicology" OR "ecotoxicology" OR "zebrafish" OR "tea" OR "plant tissue" OR "food fermentation" OR "beverage")
queries.biorxiv_query: "digital twin" bioprocess (bioreactor OR "machine learning" OR hybrid)

queries.name: Recombinant Subunit, VLP & OMV Vaccine Production
queries.pubmed_query: ("recombinant subunit"[tiab] OR "virus-like particle"[tiab] OR "virus-like particles"[tiab] OR "VLP"[tiab] OR "VLPs"[tiab] OR "outer membrane vesicle"[tiab] OR "outer membrane vesicles"[tiab] OR "OMV"[tiab] OR "OMVs"[tiab]) AND (vaccine[tiab] OR "vaccine production"[tiab] OR "vaccine manufacturing"[tiab]) AND (bioprocess[tiab] OR biomanufacturing[tiab] OR purification[tiab] OR chromatography[tiab] OR fermentation[tiab] OR titer[tiab] OR yield[tiab]) NOT ("toxicology"[tiab] OR "ecotoxicology"[tiab] OR "zebrafish"[tiab] OR "tea"[tiab] OR "soil"[tiab])
queries.biorxiv_query: ("recombinant subunit" OR "virus-like particle" OR "VLP" OR "OMV") AND (vaccine OR bioprocess OR manufacturing)

queries.name: Microbiome & Commensal Biotherapeutics / Vaccine Platforms
queries.pubmed_query: ("live biotherapeutic"[tiab] OR "next-generation probiotic"[tiab] OR "next generation probiotic"[tiab] OR "commensal"[tiab] OR "Bacteroides"[tiab]) AND (manufactur*[tiab] OR "process development"[tiab] OR lyophiliz*[tiab] OR viability[tiab] OR cGMP[tiab]) NOT ("toxicology"[tiab] OR "ecotoxicology"[tiab] OR "zebrafish"[tiab] OR "tea"[tiab] OR "soil"[tiab] OR "daqu"[tiab] OR "manure"[tiab] OR "compost"[tiab])
queries.biorxiv_query: "live biotherapeutic" OR "commensal vaccine" (bioprocess OR fermentation OR formulation)

queries.name: Bacterial & Mammalian Expression, Construct Design & Stability
queries.pubmed_query: ("Escherichia coli" OR "E. coli" OR "CHO cells" OR "HEK293" OR "mammalian expression" OR "bacterial expression") AND ("construct design" OR "codon optimization" OR "signal peptide" OR "plasmid" OR "inclusion bodies" OR "protein folding") AND (yield OR titer OR stability OR solubility OR aggregation OR troubleshooting) NOT ("toxicology" OR "ecotoxicology" OR "zebrafish" OR "tea" OR "food fermentation" OR "beverage" OR "wine" OR "beer")
queries.biorxiv_query: ("codon optimization" OR "signal peptide" OR "inclusion body" OR "construct design") AND (expression OR yield OR stability)

queries.name: Early-Phase cGMP Manufacturing & First-in-Human Materials
queries.pubmed_query: ("first-in-human" OR "phase 1" OR "clinical trial material") AND ("GMP manufacturing" OR "clinical batch" OR "drug substance" OR "bioprocess" OR "cGMP" OR "closed system" OR "scale-out" OR "single-use" OR "modular manufacturing" OR "cleanroom") AND (biopharmaceutical OR biologic OR "monoclonal antibody" OR vaccine OR ("cell therapy" AND ("GMP manufacturing" OR "clinical batch" OR "drug substance" OR "bioprocess" OR "cGMP"))) NOT ("toxicology" OR "ecotoxicology" OR "zebrafish" OR "tea" OR "food fermentation" OR "beverage" OR "wine" OR "beer")
queries.biorxiv_query: ("cGMP" OR "first-in-human" OR "closed system" OR "scale-out") AND (manufacturing OR clinical)
